title: What to do when you're on a Psychology reserve list

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr Marianne Trent），自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两届心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，且无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场大师班指导、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特南-梅森（Fortnum and Mason）甜点，以及限时的一对一辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Hi, today on the Aspiring Psychologist podcast,
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听今天的“有志心理学家播客”，

sentences.en: I am guiding you through my seven top tips for how to cope with waiting lists and reserve lists in psychology and mental health jobs.
sentences.zh: 我将指导你了解七大顶级技巧，教你如何应对心理学和心理健康工作中的候补名单和预备名单。

sentences.en: Stay right to the end to soak up all my advice and guidance.
sentences.zh: 请坚持听到最后，以吸收我所有的建议和指导。

sentences.en: I hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这些非常有用。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, let's be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正寻求成为一名心理学家，让我们来做你的向导。

sentences.en: It's the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 这就是由玛丽安·特伦特博士主持的“有志心理学家播客”。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到“有志心理学家播客”。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: You might well know that I've got a social media presence.
sentences.zh: 你可能很清楚我在社交媒体上很活跃。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我到处都是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: And today's episode was a special request from somebody on my socials.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目是根据我社交媒体上某位粉丝的特别请求制作的。

sentences.en: Today, we are thinking about that exquisite hell, which is a waiting list or a reserve liSt.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来思考那种精致的地狱，即候补名单或预备名单。

sentences.en: This usually crops up when it comes to doctoral training courses, but also might well happen in undergraduate or master's study.
sentences.zh: 这通常在涉及博士培训课程时出现，但也可能发生在本科或硕士学习中。

sentences.en: And it's possible that it happens in relevant experience roles, too.
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况也可能发生在相关的经验职位中。

sentences.en: And today I am offering my advice and guidance on how to navigate being on a waiting liSt.
sentences.zh: 今天我将提供关于如何应对处于候补名单上的建议和指导。

sentences.en: Now, in case you're not sure what I mean when I say reserve list or waiting list, let me explain.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你不确定我说“预备名单”或“候补名单”是什么意思，让我来解释一下。

sentences.en: So, for example, in clinical psychology, there might be 25 places available for the doctoral program.
sentences.zh: 例如，在临床心理学中，博士项目可能有25个可用名额。

sentences.en: But they will usually see probably about 75 to 80, maybe even 100 people at interview for those posts.
sentences.zh: 但他们通常会为这些岗位安排大约75到80人，甚至可能是100人进行面试。

sentences.en: Now, the people that they feel are not appointable will likely be sent a thanks, but no thanks.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们认为不适合录用的人可能会收到一封“谢谢，但不用了”的信。

sentences.en: But the people that they feel are of the standard and the caliber that they would want to be having within their program of study might well be offered a reserve list place.
sentences.zh: 但是，对于那些他们认为符合标准和水平，并且希望纳入其学习项目的人，可能会获得预备名单的名额。

sentences.en: So that's what we're talking about today.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们今天讨论的内容。

sentences.en: People that have essentially made the grade, but they're waiting for people to be able to either be interviewed elsewhere
sentences.zh: 这些人基本上达到了标准，但他们正在等待别人能够在其他地方参加面试

sentences.en: and then decline their place that they've been offered, which then bumps everybody up the waiting list or, you know,
sentences.zh: 然后拒绝他们已经获得的录取名额，这反过来会使每个人在候补名单上上升，或者，你知道的，

sentences.en: for them to decide to then accept that waiting list place, which then, you know, doesn't change your position on the waiting liSt.
sentences.zh: 让他们决定接受候补名单的名额，这然后，你知道的，不会改变你在候补名单上的位置。

sentences.en: So in today's episode, I'm going to be guiding you through my seven areas of consideration for this.
sentences.zh: 所以在今天的节目中，我将引导你了解我对此的七个考虑领域。

sentences.en: But firstly, before I do that, let me tell you about my own experience of waiting lists.
sentences.zh: 但首先，在此之前，让我告诉你我自己关于候补名单的经历。

sentences.en: For the course that I ended up studying with, I was offered one of the 15 places outright.
sentences.zh: 对于我最终就读的课程，我直接获得了15个名额中的一个。

sentences.en: But for the course that I was also offered, I was first reserve.
sentences.zh: 但对于我也获得录取的另一门课程，我是第一候补。

sentences.en: Now, not everybody gets given a number these days for what position you are on the liSt.
sentences.zh: 现在，如今并不是每个人都会得到一个数字来告诉你你在名单上的位置。

sentences.en: But if you do have a number and you end up as first reserve, it's usually almost possibly guaranteed that you might well be getting an offer.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你确实有一个数字并且最终成为第一候补，通常几乎可以保证你可能会获得录取通知。

sentences.en: Because, of course, a cohort of, you know, up to 40-ish plus people, it's likely that some people are being offered multiple course offers
sentences.zh: 因为，当然，一个多达40人左右的 cohort，很可能有些人会收到多个课程录取通知

sentences.en: and that, you know, the one that you've been offered might not be their first choice,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你被录取的那个可能不是他们的第一选择，

sentences.en: either for geographical reasons or, you know, personal reasons or just because they don't like the course as much as the one that they are going to accept.
sentences.zh: 无论是出于地理原因，还是个人原因，或者仅仅是因为他们不如将要接受的那门课程那样喜欢这门课。

sentences.en: So there's a number of reasons why people might wait.
sentences.zh: 所以人们等待的原因有很多。

sentences.en: And, of course, what we know certainly about the doctorate in clinical psychology is that there's an interview season that starts in March and ends in May.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们对临床心理学博士课程非常清楚的是，面试季从3月开始，5月结束。

sentences.en: And they try very carefully not to overlap too much geographically.
sentences.zh: 他们非常小心地避免在地理位置上重叠太多。

sentences.en: And, of course, if you were having interviews, it's possible that you might well have an interview in the first week of interviews in March.
sentences.zh: 而且，当然，如果你要参加面试，你很可能会在3月的第一周面试季中有一场面试。

sentences.en: And you might still have interviews in the last weeks in May.
sentences.zh: 并且你可能在5月的最后几周仍然有面试。

sentences.en: And so your application, your interview season might well be very well spread out.
sentences.zh: 所以你的申请和面试季可能会拉得很长。

sentences.en: So you might have been offered a place from the first set of interviews that you did in March or April or even May.
sentences.zh: 因此，你可能在3月、4月甚至5月进行的第一轮面试中就获得了录取名额。

sentences.en: But then you are holding out hope or you just want to consider your options.
sentences.zh: 但随后你抱有希望，或者你只是想考虑你的选择。

sentences.en: And then you might well be offered a place to places later in the season as well.
sentences.zh: 然后你很可能会在赛季晚些时候获得一两个名额的录取。

sentences.en: And you just want to be super well informed and to get a feel for that course, how it makes you feel and, you know, whether you would want to do a programme of study there.
sentences.zh: 你只是想获得充分的信息，感受一下这门课程，它带给你的感觉，以及，你知道的，你是否愿意在那里学习一个课程项目。

sentences.en: And so you absolutely don't have to make your mind up.
sentences.zh: 所以你绝对不需要马上做决定。

sentences.en: I did an episode recently, which is episode 74, that you might also want to check out.
sentences.zh: 我最近做了一期节目，也就是第74集，你可能也会想去看看。

sentences.en: And that was about, well, should you still go to interviews if you've been offered a place elsewhere?
sentences.zh: 那是关于，如果你在其他地方获得了录取名额，你是否还应该去参加面试？

sentences.en: So you might find that useful as well.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: And, of course, another reason that I forgot to include in that podcast episode is that you might want to go and see how your performance compares.
sentences.zh: 当然，我在那期播客中忘记包含的另一个原因是，你可能想去看看你的表现如何。

sentences.en: You know, once you know you've got a course offer, you might want to go and just feel a bit more at peace and at ease.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一旦你知道你获得了课程录取，你可能想去感受一下内心的平静和轻松。

sentences.en: And it might feel that you're more able to be just yourself and to really bring your arousal levels back down to a more comfortable yellow window of tolerance zone of functioning.
sentences.zh: 并且你可能会觉得你更能做自己，真正将你的唤醒水平拉回到一个更舒适的黄色容忍窗口功能区。

sentences.en: And that's OK.
sentences.zh: 这没关系。

sentences.en: You know, you've been offered those interviews.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你已经获得了这些面试机会。

sentences.en: It is your choice if you wish to accept the interviews or not.
sentences.zh: 是否接受面试是你的选择。

sentences.en: Anyway, that's a whole nother podcast episode.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，那是完全另一期的播客了。

sentences.en: Today, we are thinking about how to cope with reserve list places.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们正在思考如何应对预备名单名额。

sentences.en: Because, of course, it does somewhat hold you in limbo.
sentences.zh: 因为，当然，这确实在某种程度上让你处于悬而未决的状态。

sentences.en: So it holds you in limbo until you know the outcome of interviews, which has to happen by the 2nd of June 2023 for the declinside process.
sentences.zh: 所以它让你悬而未决，直到你知道面试的结果，对于拒绝流程来说，这必须在2023年6月2日之前发生。

sentences.en: And people need to have responded by the 9th of June 2023.
sentences.zh: 人们需要在2023年6月9日之前回复。

sentences.en: So hopefully you should know either way, I guess, by the week after the 9th of June.
sentences.zh: 所以希望你无论如何都应该知道，我猜，在6月9日之后的一周内。

sentences.en: But, of course, that said, I have heard of people being offered places on training in, you know, late August and September as people's circumstances change across the summer.
sentences.zh: 但是，话虽如此，我听说过有人在8月下旬和9月随着夏天人们情况的变化而获得培训名额的。

sentences.en: This is a whole lot easier to manage if you know the numbers.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道具体数字，这要管理起来容易得多。

sentences.en: If you know, for example, that you are number 30 on the reserve list and there's only 22 places, it's possibly looking less likely that you'll be offered a place that year.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道，例如，你是预备名单上的第30位，而只有22个名额，那么你当年获得录取的可能性可能较小。

sentences.en: But I know some courses have moved to not giving numbers, which adds more layers of, you know, anxiety, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我知道有些课程已经不再提供具体数字，这增加了更多的焦虑感，我认为。

sentences.en: And feeling very distracted, discombobulated, not really knowing, you know, which basket to put your apples in.
sentences.zh: 并且感觉非常分心、混乱，真的不知道，你知道的，把鸡蛋放在哪个篮子里。

sentences.en: Because if you know, you know, you're number 1 or 2, 3, 4, 5, then you think, oh, OK, this could be happening.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你知道，你知道你是第1、2、3、4、5位，那么你会想，哦，好的，这可能会发生。

sentences.en: But if you're number 60, I don't know how high some of the course lists go with their reserve lists, then it's possibly unlikely.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是第60位，我不知道有些课程的预备名单有多高，那么这可能不太可能。

sentences.en: So let me start guiding you through our top tips and considerations for how to tackle this beaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以让我开始引导你了解我们应对这个怪兽的顶级技巧和考虑事项。

sentences.en: So if I was in your position on a waiting list, I would, I guess, try to be thinking about my mindset.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我处在你处于候补名单的位置，我猜我会尽量考虑我的心态。

sentences.en: And I'm not going to be gaslighting myself with false promise necessarily.
sentences.zh: 我不一定会用虚假的承诺来对自我进行煤气灯式的操纵（自我欺骗）。

sentences.en: But, you know, I do like the idea of a little bit of manifestation.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我确实喜欢一点意念显化的想法。

sentences.en: And so I'd be doing some compassionate flows out there into the world to let this opportunity come to me.
sentences.zh: 因此，我会向世界释放一些富有同情心的流动，让这个机会来到我身边。

sentences.en: What is the worst that can happen with doing that?
sentences.zh: 这样做最坏的结果是什么？

sentences.en: Granted, you might feel a little bit silly when you begin to do that.
sentences.zh: 诚然，当你开始这样做时，你可能会觉得有点傻。

sentences.en: But I promise you that over time, that will ease.
sentences.zh: 但我向你保证，随着时间的推移，这种感觉会减轻。

sentences.en: And it feels like you're doing something, you know, to help control this situation that might well feel uncontrollable.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像你在做一些事情，你知道的，来帮助控制这个可能感觉无法控制的局面。

sentences.en: And as part of this tip, it's important to remember that, of course, you are of the appropriate calibre to be offered this opportunity.
sentences.zh: 作为这个技巧的一部分，重要的是要记住，当然，你具备获得这个机会的适当才华。

sentences.en: And so you need to really take something from that.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要真正从中汲取一些东西。

sentences.en: You know, for example, if it is a trainee psychologist role, then you know that you are of the right standard.
sentences.zh: 你知道，例如，如果这是一个实习心理学家职位，那么你知道你符合标准。

sentences.en: You are saying the right things, you are doing the right things, you're presenting yourself in the right way to be offered that role.
sentences.zh: 你在说正确的话，你在做正确的事，你以正确的方式展现自己以获得该职位。

sentences.en: And you've got to feel really proud of yourself for that.
sentences.zh: 你必须为此感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: Consideration number two.
sentences.zh: 考虑事项二。

sentences.en: So number two is about potentially seeking feedback.
sentences.zh: 所以第二点是关于潜在地寻求反馈。

sentences.en: So, you know, whilst technically they may not tell you what number you are on the reserve lists,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，虽然从技术上讲他们可能不会告诉你你在预备名单上的名次，

sentences.en: I've been known to, you know, to make friends with people on admin departments and see what you can find out.
sentences.zh: 我过去常常，你知道的，和行政部门的人交朋友，看看你能打听出什么。

sentences.en: So seeking feedback about your performance in the interview can be useful to know what it is that, you know, that went really well.
sentences.zh: 所以寻求关于你在面试中表现的反馈，可以帮助你了解什么事情，你知道的，进展得非常顺利。

sentences.en: Even though you were successful, you're on a reserve list,
sentences.zh: 尽管你成功了，你在预备名单上，

sentences.en: it can be useful to get a little bit more clarification about what might have helped you score more points to get you across the line.
sentences.zh: 获得更多关于什么可能帮助你获得更多分数以跨过终点线的澄清，可能会很有用。

sentences.en: But yeah, if you can, it's really useful to get the number that you're at, just so that you can manage your own expectations accordingly, really.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，如果可以的话，获取你的排名真的很有用，这样你就可以相应地管理好自己的期望。

sentences.en: It can also be useful, even if they won't tell you how many places are left on the reserve list, to ask them maybe how many people are still waiting to confirm places.
sentences.zh: 这也会很有用，即使他们不告诉你预备名单上还剩多少名额，也可以问他们可能还有多少人在等待确认名额。

sentences.en: So if there's only one or two out of a cohort of 40, 40 plus, then it might be less likely.
sentences.zh: 所以如果在一个40多人以上的 cohort 中只有一两个人在等待，那么可能性可能会小一些。

sentences.en: But if actually out of a cohort that size, they're still waiting for 15 or 20 people to confirm, then, you know, you can help manage your expectations in that way.
sentences.zh: 但如果实际上在这么大一个 cohort 中，他们仍在等待15或20人确认，那么，你知道，你可以通过这种方式帮助管理你的期望。

sentences.en: Consideration number three is all about the power of your network, other people's network and networking.
sentences.zh: 考虑事项三全是关于你的人脉、其他人的人脉以及人脉网络的力量。

sentences.en: How can you connect with people either in person or perhaps on social media to, you know, to feel validated,
sentences.zh: 你如何能够与人建立联系，无论是面对面还是可能在社交媒体上，以，你知道的，获得认可，

sentences.en: to feel like you're understood and to think about how you might be able to benefit from the skills and the wisdom of other people who get it and might perhaps be the next stage ahead of you in your career.
sentences.zh: 感觉到被理解，并思考你如何能够受益于其他懂这些的人的技能和智慧，他们可能在你的职业生涯中比你领先一个阶段。

sentences.en: It might involve going to conferences, professional events, meetings, anything you can think of or find to continue to increase your exposure to people in your area of specialty,
sentences.zh: 这可能涉及去参加会议、专业活动、会议，任何你能想到或找到的能增加你在专业领域接触人群机会的事情，

sentences.en: but also those who, you know, might be able to help enrich your knowledge, understanding and how supported you feel along the way.
sentences.zh: 同时也包括那些能够，你知道的，帮助丰富你的知识、理解以及一路上感受到多少支持的人。

sentences.en: And that has been a really nice and unexpected feature of the aspiring psychologist membership because the community are so wonderful in rallying together and supporting one another and helping celebrate wins,
sentences.zh: 这是“有志心理学家会员”一个非常棒且意想不到的特色，因为社区里的大家在齐心协力、互相支持以及庆祝胜利方面真是太棒了，

sentences.en: but also helping to to kind of process any complex or complicated feelings which might come up.
sentences.zh: 同时也帮助处理任何可能出现的复杂或纠结的情绪。

sentences.en: So if you are missing people that feel like your tribe at the moment, you might well consider joining the aspiring psychologist membership.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你现在正怀念那些感觉像你的部落的人，你可能完全可以考虑加入有志心理学家会员。

sentences.en: And this leads us nicely into consideration number four.
sentences.zh: 这很好地引导我们进入考虑事项四。

sentences.en: So I always think that if you're on a reserve list,
sentences.zh: 所以我总是认为，如果你在预备名单上，

sentences.en: it can be useful to think about it possibly as being a no and thinking about what you need to do to be able to get yourself in a position that the next time there's jobs up,
sentences.zh: 认为它可能是一个“不”，并思考你需要做什么才能让自己处于这样一种状态：下次有工作机会时，

sentences.en: that you are given an outright yes rather than a maybe.
sentences.zh: 你得到的是一个直接的“是”，而不是一个“也许”，这会很有用。

sentences.en: And so how can you look at your strengths and weaknesses profile to think about what might need padding out, what might need thickening, you know, enhancing,
sentences.zh: 所以你如何审视自己的优势和劣势档案，来思考什么可能需要填补，什么可能需要加厚，你知道的，增强，

sentences.en: reducing your Achilles heel for that area.
sentences.zh: 减少你在该领域的阿喀琉斯之踵（致命弱点）。

sentences.en: So it might well be that you want to focus on online training or in-person training events,
sentences.zh: 所以你很可能会想专注于在线培训或面对面的培训活动，

sentences.en: that you want to immerse yourself in the literature and the research in the areas that you want to work in ultimately.
sentences.zh: 让你自己沉浸在你最终想要工作的领域的文献和研究中。

sentences.en: If you're an aspiring clinical psychologist, it might well be that you'd like to attend workshops with qualified professionals to help advance your skills and your confidence.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名有志向的临床心理学家，你很可能会想参加合格专业人士的研讨会，以帮助提升你的技能和信心。

sentences.en: And of course, that will always benefit you if you do end up getting that reserve list place as well.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你最终确实获得了那个预备名单名额，这也将永远对你有利。

sentences.en: And please do know that when you get on from a reserve list place, it's just a place, you know, it's no different.
sentences.zh: 请一定要知道，当你从预备名单上被录用时，它只是一个名额，你知道的，没有什么不同。

sentences.en: You are a member of the cohort and you deserve to be there.
sentences.zh: 你是 cohort 的一员，你理应在那里。

sentences.en: So this chance to upskill and thicken this narrative can be really important in helping you both now to feel like you're getting that control back.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个提升技能和充实这一叙事的机会对于帮助你现在找回这种掌控感非常重要。

sentences.en: But also in future, if it doesn't work out, this opportunity that you are going to be in a stronger position next time around.
sentences.zh: 而且在未来，如果这次没有成功，这个机会将确保你在下一次处于更有利的地位。

sentences.en: And again, this is something aspiring psychologist membership is really, really good at.
sentences.zh: 同样，这也是有志心理学家会员非常非常擅长的事情。

sentences.en: If you'd like information about how to join, please do check out the information in the description if you're watching on YouTube or in the show notes if you're listening on audio.
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解如何加入的信息，如果你在YouTube上观看，请查看简介中的信息，或者如果你在听音频，请查看节目笔记。

sentences.en: Now is a really nice opportunity to play a little jingle for one of the books and I will catch you on the other side for our next three of our seven considerations.
sentences.zh: 现在是一个非常好的机会，为其中一本书播放一段小音乐，我将在另一端等你，继续我们的七个考虑事项中的最后三个。

sentences.en: If you're enjoying the content, please do like and subscribe and drop a comment in for me to see you very soon.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢这些内容，请点赞并订阅，并留下评论，以便我很快能见到你。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: So in the first half,
sentences.zh: 所以在前半部分，

sentences.en: we were thinking about four of our top seven considerations for how to manage the sweet hell that can be being on reserve lists for training or job opportunities.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在思考七大顶级考虑事项中的前四个，关于如何应对处于培训或工作机会预备名单上的那种甜蜜的地狱。

sentences.en: Let's crash straight on with number five.
sentences.zh: 让我们直接切入第五点。

sentences.en: So number five is all about expanding your search and broadening your horizons.
sentences.zh: 所以第五点完全是关于扩大你的搜索和拓宽你的视野。

sentences.en: It might well be that you start to look at other opportunities out there.
sentences.zh: 你很可能会开始寻找外面的其他机会。

sentences.en: So, for example, there's not only one way to get qualified as a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，获得心理学家资格并非只有一条途径。

sentences.en: It might be that you are able to look at whether counselling psychology might be a good fit for you or whether, for example,
sentences.zh: 你可能能够看看咨询心理学是否适合你，或者例如，

sentences.en: as Anagar Sharma and I explored together in episode 57 of the podcast,
sentences.zh: 正如阿纳加·夏尔马（Anagar Sharma）和我一起在播客第57集中探讨的那样，

sentences.en: there was the little known way to get qualified as a clinical psychologist is to do the dual discipline and do forensic psychology as well.
sentences.zh: 有一个鲜为人知的成为合格临床心理学家的途径，那就是攻读双学科并同时攻读法医心理学。

sentences.en: Now, these are, of course, self-funded routes,
sentences.zh: 现在，这些当然是自费路线，

sentences.en: but it's worth just exploring what that would look like and how you might be able to either get that funded from an employer or how you might be able to afford other self-funding options.
sentences.zh: 但值得探讨一下这会是什么样子，以及你如何能够从雇主那里获得资金支持，或者你如何能够负担其他自费选项。

sentences.en: It might be that you use this time to think about maybe potentially applying for other relevant roles, which might help strengthen your chances the next time around,
sentences.zh: 你可能会利用这段时间来考虑可能潜在地申请其他相关角色，这可能有助于在下一次加强你的胜算，

sentences.en: in case these reserve list places don't work out.
sentences.zh: 以防这些预备名单名额最终没有成功。

sentences.en: That might look like applying for other assistant psychology roles.
sentences.zh: 这可能看起来像是申请其他助理心理学家职位。

sentences.en: It might look like applying for a master's.
sentences.zh: 这可能看起来像是申请硕士学位。

sentences.en: It could look like doing some additional skills or qualification.
sentences.zh: 这可能看起来像是做一些额外的技能或资质培训。

sentences.en: It could look like doing some additional skills training in a particular area that you want to strengthen, for example,
sentences.zh: 这可能看起来像是进行一些特定领域的额外技能培训，你想加以强化，例如，

sentences.en: on CBT or working with specific populations or using specific approaches.
sentences.zh: 关于CBT（认知行为疗法）或与特定人群合作或使用特定方法。

sentences.en: And again, this is something that we really excel at in the aspiring psychologist membership.
sentences.zh: 同样，这也是我们在有志心理学家会员中真正擅长的领域。

sentences.en: And people might be like, oh, well, should I be applying for jobs if I might be letting them down at the last minute?
sentences.zh: 人们可能会想：“哦，好吧，如果我可能会在最后一刻让雇主失望，我应该申请工作吗？”

sentences.en: But you've got to look after yourself.
sentences.zh: 但你必须照顾好自己。

sentences.en: It's OK to do that.
sentences.zh: 这样做是可以的。

sentences.en: It's OK to put your own needs firSt.
sentences.zh: 把自己的需求放在第一位是可以的。

sentences.en: And of course, employers understand that people's positions will change all of the time for a variety of reasons.
sentences.zh: 当然，雇主们也理解，由于各种原因，人们的职位会随时发生变化。

sentences.en: So perhaps you're working in children's services and you've never worked with people with intellectual disabilities or perhaps you're working in intellectual disabilities.
sentences.zh: 所以也许你一直在儿童服务部门工作，从未与智力障碍人士共事过，或者你可能在智力障碍服务部门工作过。

sentences.en: You've never worked with older adults.
sentences.zh: 但你从未与老年人共事过。

sentences.en: You've never worked with working age adults.
sentences.zh: 你从未与适龄成年人共事过。

sentences.en: It's OK to think about what opportunities there might be around at this time to help strengthen your abilities.
sentences.zh: 在这个时候，思考一下周围有哪些机会可以帮助你增强能力，是完全可以的。

sentences.en: And of course, this time of year is a good time to be looking for jobs because as people get on clinical training,
sentences.zh: 当然，每年的这个时候都是找工作的好时机，因为当人们参加临床培训时，

sentences.en: sometimes people resign right away once they've got that unconditional offer because they want to spend the summer doing something different.
sentences.zh: 有时人们一拿到无条件录取通知书就会立刻辞职，因为他们想花个夏天做点不一样的尝试。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, this is a potentially exciting time for the job market over the next few months.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，对于接下来几个月的就业市场来说，这可能是一个令人兴奋的时期。

sentences.en: So consideration number six is just staying focused, staying persistent, staying enthusiastic,
sentences.zh: 因此，第六个注意事项就是保持专注，保持坚持，保持热情，

sentences.en: staying polite as you go about your inquiries about what position you are on the liSt.
sentences.zh: 在询问自己处于候补名单什么位置时，保持礼貌。

sentences.en: You know, they will, of course, understand the level of anxiety that you might be experiencing because it does make a big difference.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们当然会理解你可能正在经历的焦虑程度，因为这确实带来了很大的不同。

sentences.en: You know, if somebody is potentially preparing to move from London to Scotland, for example, that's not something that should be done without planning and without consideration.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比方说，如果有人正准备从伦敦搬到苏格兰，那可不是不加规划和考虑就能做的事情。

sentences.en: So they will understand, you know, what this means to you.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会理解，你知道，这对你意味着什么。

sentences.en: And hopefully they will be kind to you in their interactions with you, too.
sentences.zh: 希望他们在与你的互动中也能对你友好一些。

sentences.en: Consideration number seven is last but not leaSt.
sentences.zh: 第七个注意事项，也是至关重要的一点。

sentences.en: It's managing your own expectations.
sentences.zh: 那就是管理好你自己的期望。

sentences.en: So it would have been preferable for you to be given an outright place.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你能直接获得一个名额，那是再好不过了。

sentences.en: Of course it would.
sentences.zh: 当然是这样。

sentences.en: But it might not happen for you this year.
sentences.zh: 但今年你可能不会如愿以偿。

sentences.en: And that is going to evoke lots of complicated feelings.
sentences.zh: 这将会引发许多复杂的情绪。

sentences.en: It might make you feel quite sad, you know, quite rejected, even that you're not good enough, that you're not measuring up, that others are better.
sentences.zh: 它可能会让你感到相当难过，你知道的，甚至会有一种被拒绝的感觉，觉得你不够优秀，觉得你达不到标准，觉得别人比你更好。

sentences.en: And all of those thoughts and feelings are really normal.
sentences.zh: 所有这些想法和感受都是非常正常的。

sentences.en: But we also need to be thinking about letting our compassionate other help us through this.
sentences.zh: 但我们也需要考虑让内心的同情部分来帮助我们度过难关。

sentences.en: There's not a lot of good that comes from self-criticism.
sentences.zh: 自我批判带不来多少好处。

sentences.en: So you might well want to plan something that, you know, is going to be a real celebration of where you're at right now.
sentences.zh: 所以你很可能会想策划一些事情，你知道的，能够真正庆祝你目前所处状态的事情。

sentences.en: So if you think it's unlikely that you'll get onto training this year, then could you go and have a lovely holiday in September, October or at some point during that year,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你认为今年不太可能获得培训机会，那么你是否可以在九月、月或者那一年的某个时候去度个美好的假，

sentences.en: which might have been trickier for you to do if you were doing this job or training offer that you might well not be offered.
sentences.zh: 如果你当时在做这份工作或者去参加你可能最终没能获得的培训录取，这可能会更难实现。

sentences.en: How can you use this time really wonderfully?
sentences.zh: 你该如何好好利用这段时间呢？

sentences.en: So it might be that you want to use this time to really celebrate your life where you're at right now.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可能会想利用这段时间来好好庆祝你目前的生活状态。

sentences.en: It might involve getting married.
sentences.zh: 这可能涉及结婚。

sentences.en: It might involve moving house.
sentences.zh: 这可能涉及搬家。

sentences.en: You know, it's about knowing that where you're at right now is, you know, it's OK to feel happy and content there and to to grow roots and spread your wings.
sentences.zh: 你知道，关键是要知道，你现在所处的状况，你知道的，在那里感到快乐和满足是没问题的，去扎根并展翅翱翔吧。

sentences.en: And you just see what happens next time around.
sentences.zh: 然后看看下一次会发生什么。

sentences.en: So just in summary, our top seven considerations were staying positive and proactive, seeking feedback if possible, continual networking, enhancing your skills,
sentences.zh: 总之，我们的前七个注意事项是：保持积极和积极主动，可能的话寻求反馈，不断拓展人脉，提升技能，

sentences.en: expanding your search, staying updated and persistent and last but not least, managing your expectations.
sentences.zh: 扩大搜索范围，保持关注并坚持不懈，最后但同样重要的是，管理好你的期望。

sentences.en: I hope you found it useful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: Please know that I feel for you.
sentences.zh: 请知道我对你感同身受。

sentences.en: This is really difficult, especially if you're potentially, you know, looking to move somewhere with yourself or your family, your pets and you're just waiting to hear.
sentences.zh: 这真的很不容易，特别是如果你可能正准备和自己、家人、宠物一起搬到某个地方，而你只是在等待消息。

sentences.en: I know that this, you know, this is your life and it matters.
sentences.zh: 我知道，你知道的，这就是你的生活，它很重要。

sentences.en: Please do stay kind to yourself.
sentences.zh: 请务必对自己好一点。

sentences.en: If you found this content useful, please do like, comment, engage, rate, rate and review if listening on Spotify or Apple.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得这些内容有用，请点赞、评论、互动、评分，如果在 Spotify 或 Apple 上收听，请给予评分和评价。

sentences.en: I love providing this content for you and I love that you think it's helpful.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢为你提供这些内容，我也很高兴你觉得它们有帮助。

sentences.en: If you'd like to tip me for the work that I do, you can see links in my social media bio.
sentences.zh: 如果你想为我的工作打赏，可以在我的社交媒体个人简介中找到链接。

sentences.en: If you tend to listen by going to my website, www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk forward slash podcast for every episode, there is now a donate button as well.
sentences.zh: 如果你习惯通过访问我的网站来收听：www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk 正斜杠 podcast，现在每一集都配有一个捐赠按钮。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Please do stay kind to yourself.
sentences.zh: 请务必对自己好一点。

sentences.en: And if you could recommend the podcast to others you think might find it useful, I'd be so grateful.
sentences.zh: 如果你能把这个播客推荐给其他你认为会有用的人，我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I'll look forward to delivering you the next episode, which is available from 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我期待着为你带来下一集，该集将于周一早上 6 点发布。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出售时间之外的方式赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在 2022 年亲自完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两届心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我专属的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、福特纳姆与梅森美食礼品，以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
